name: zoom-through-transition
description: A transition that zooms through a focal card into the next scene.

vars.description: Caption on the outgoing scene, the one on screen when the transition starts.
Caption on the incoming scene, the one the timeline wipes into frame.
Multiplies how far both scenes travel and how hard the outgoing one blurs, so the push covers a shorter or longer run in the same time.
Theme token for the ring marking the incoming scene. Blue rides --accent, green --brand, violet --accent-2; each falls back to a neutral hairline.
